name: NAFCO Co., Ltd.
summary: NAFCO Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the operation of home and furniture retail stores in Japan. It operates through three segments: Materials, DIY, and Gardening Supplies; Livingware; and Furniture and Home Fashion Items. The company offers home improvement products, including DIY, gardening, exterior, and pet supplies, car accessories, household goods, interior products, and other items; and furniture and home fashion products, such storage, dining, living room, wedding, study, and small furniture, as well as beds and beddings.
